The '''Ceriun system''' was located in the [[Nuiri sector/Legends|Nuiri sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ceriun]] was a part of this [[Star system/Legends|star system]].
